summary: The IIHS safety ratings that never appear in truck ads: the back seat test most pickups fail, headlights, the new automatic braking test and hood height research. Every rating comes from a published source, listed below.

GM Authority, 2026 GMC Canyon marginal in updated moderate overlap (Sept 3, 2026): https://gmauthority.com/blog/2026/09/2026-gmc-canyon-fails-iihs-updated-moderate-overlap-crash-test-video/
